meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 安装后，机器人会新增DeltaChat通道，通过电子邮件收发消息，支持端到端加密。启动时自动连接配置好的邮箱，用户可在DeltaChat内直接与机器人聊天。
howto.when: 当用户通过DeltaChat向机器人发送消息时触发；首次需先执行安装命令并配置邮箱账户。

say.note: 开始安装适配器并配置账户。
需要提供邮箱、密码和IMAP/SMTP设置。
将群消息路由到已有智能体。

howto.what_en: After installation, the bot gets a DeltaChat channel that sends and receives messages over email with end-to-end encryption. It connects to the configured mailbox on startup; users can chat with the bot directly inside DeltaChat.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user sends a message to the bot via DeltaChat. First-time setup requires running the install commands and configuring mailbox credentials.

say_en.text: Please integrate the DeltaChat channel for me.
say_en.note: Starts installing the adapter and configuring.

say_en.text: Set up the DeltaChat mailbox account.
say_en.note: Requires email, password, and IMAP/SMTP settings.

say_en.text: Connect my DeltaChat group to the agent.
say_en.note: Routes group messages to an existing agent.
